en.topic_title: Survivors battle pain, loss one year after deadly Hong Kong blaze
en.topic_summary:
Yip Ka-kui survived Hong Kong’s deadliest fire in decades, but he lost his home and his wife. Their half-melted wedding rings are among the few traces that remain of their lives.



Hongkongers pay tribute on December 2, 2025, to the victims who died in the fatal fire in Tai Po Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. 



A year after the devastating November 26, 2025 fire killed 168 people in a Hong Kong housing estate, survivors and bereaved families are struggling with their loss.



AFP
